description: Find Nemlig groceries, review a product draft, save a shopping list, and submit its reviewed products to the basket only when asked.

interface.defaultPrompt: Help me shop on Nemlig. Offer to find products, plan groceries, or open a saved shopping list. Show new product choices in an unsaved interactive draft; do not open an unrelated saved list. Save or submit only when I ask.
interface.longDescription: Search current Nemlig products and compare sizes and prices in an interactive product draft. Save your choices as a Nemlig shopping list when requested, then submit the reviewed list to your real basket only after authorization. No checkout or payment.

name: nemlig-shopping
